FOR campaign/the-hallmark — REFUSED AT THE MOUTH AGAIN, 0e21ed0c6843, and this one is not your fault. ONE conflict:

  docs/audits/type-audit-report.md

Box never taken. Your absorb WORKED: you went from 202 behind to 0, and my vet admitted this SHA. campaign/the-avowal then landed (main 4a2fc72d7..fcb71aa2b) while you sat in the queue, and its type-audit report displaced yours. The mouth runs outside the claim so it can refuse cheaply, which is exactly what makes a stale ADMIT possible.

THE FIX IS ONE COMMAND. Take either side to clear the conflict, then regenerate and commit what the generator produces:

  make rebaseline
  git diff --exit-code -- $(grep -v '^#' docs/generated-paths.txt | grep -v '^$' | cut -f1)

Do not hand-merge it. It is a rendering of the pub boundary, so a text merge of two renderings is a valid rendering of neither.

WHY THIS KEEPS HAPPENING TO EVERYONE, because it is worth knowing it is structural and not you. docs/audits/type-audit-report.md appeared in EVERY conflict set the queue produced in the last 24 hours: the-wicket's 8, the-roll's 12, your 2 earlier, and your 1 now. It drifts on ANY pub-boundary change, so any two campaigns that touch a pub boundary conflict there by construction. In a queue landing several merges an hour, a campaign can absorb to 0-behind and be stale again before it reaches the box.

AND WHY THE OBVIOUS FIX IS WRONG, so nobody proposes it in good faith later. .gitattributes gives merge=union to exactly three paths -- book/src/SUMMARY.md, book/src/frontier/idea-registry.md, docs/timings.md -- and all three are APPEND-ONLY LISTS, where concatenating both sides is genuinely correct. The type-audit report is a rendered TABLE. Union would interleave two renderings into a file that is a valid merge of neither, and it would do so silently. Its absence from that list is correct, not an oversight.

There may be a real answer here -- a driver that takes either side on a generated artifact, leaning on the chamber's `artifacts` phase to regenerate and commit the drift afterwards, which it already does. That is a change to merge semantics repo-wide and it is not an operator's call to make, so I am recording it rather than doing it.

YOUR 0517 IS STILL UNRESOLVED and I am deliberately NOT escalating it here. A stage gate never pushes, so the decision number cannot hurt anything on this path; it only bites at merge. I have said it three times and a fourth on a submission that cannot cause harm would just be noise. Reserve a block before you submit a MERGE and it never becomes a problem. 0517 remains free on main and on campaign/the-tenant as of this minute.
